summary: Fifth-iteration retest of The Feeling Field. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases pass; /api/emotions grid bounds verified (-6..6 both axes); POST /api/emotions/generate {x:2,y:-3} returns 200 with name+description. Frontend (Playwright, 1920x1080, public URL): ALL requested checks PASS — (1) neighbor return-to-rest is now smooth: bubble-1-0 displaced +8.8px on hovering bubble-0-0, then decayed 9.06 -> 8.19 -> 6.59 -> 4.90 -> 3.35 -> 2.09 -> 1.12 -> 0.43 -> -0.42 with NO single-frame jump >4px and settled to -0.42px (<2px) by t=2000ms; the old +8.4px hold then -8.16px teleport is gone. (2) Colors reverted: origin bubble .bubble-core = rgb(196,159,209) / hsl(284.5,35%,72%) (saturation 35% > 25%, not white); corners hsl(38,85%,60%) and hsl(230,85%,60%) highly saturated. (3) Detail panel shows only detail-name + detail-description; detail-coord and detail-source absent from DOM. (4) Legend collapsed by default (aria-hidden=true, clientHeight 44px), expands to 136px on toggle, recollapses to 44px. (5) Theme labels 'Light Mode'/'Dark Mode' correct; light theme applies data-theme=ethereal and renders correctly. (6) Corner bubble 6-6 hover shifts neighbor 5-6 by -5.96px and remains clickable (detail 'Exhilarated'). (7) AI generation path via click on emotion-bubble--5-4 returned 'panic' with a real description. Zero console errors, zero error elements.

minor.issue: Returns only 68 emotions, not >=80 as expected by the test spec. CURATED_EMOTIONS has 83 entries but 15 use legacy coordinates outside the current -6..6 grid and are filtered out at server.py:88. Consider remapping those 15 curated entries into the 13x13 grid.

issues: Detail panel (bottom-left) overlaps the bottom-left bubbles of the grid (rows y=-5/-6, x=-6..-3), obscuring them while open — consider offsetting the panel or adding grid padding.

Hue interpolation has a visible seam between column x=0 (mauve/desaturated) and x=1 (green): the shortest-arc hue blend makes the pleasant/unpleasant midline look like an abrupt color break rather than a smooth gradient.
Neighbor displacement is not symmetric on hover of the corner bubble: 5-6 shifted -5.96px while 6-5 only -0.68px (cosmetic, edge bubble still clickable).

action_items: Optional: remap the 15 out-of-bounds curated emotions so GET /api/emotions covers >=80 in-grid cells
Optional: reposition detail panel so it doesn't cover bottom-left bubbles
critical_code_review_comments: scheduleShrink return-phase params (alpha 0.6 / alphaDecay 0.04 / velocityDecay 0.4) with no .on('end') teleport are correct and measured working — keep as-is.
EmotionGrid.js is ~460 lines and mixes physics, data fetching and rendering; consider extracting the d3-force logic into a hook if it grows further.
seed_data_creation: POST /api/emotions/generate cached generated emotions for (2,-3), (-5,4) and clicked cells in Mongo (generated_emotions collection).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All previously failing items (neighbor snap-back, colors, detail panel, legend, theme labels, edge bubble) now pass. Remaining non-blocking items: curated emotion count (68 in-grid vs 83 defined), detail-panel overlap with bottom-left bubbles, hue seam at x=0/x=1 boundary. Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (9 tests, all green).
rca_of_the_issue: Previous HIGH-priority snap was caused by a hard teleport in simulation .on('end') plus insufficient return-phase alpha. Removing the teleport and raising alpha to 0.6 with alphaDecay 0.04 / velocityDecay 0.4 makes forceX/forceY carry displaced neighbors home smoothly; measured 31 samples over 3s show monotonic decay with max per-100ms delta ~1.7px.
